story.text: From the moment our paths first crossed, we knew our hearts were meant to walk together. Through laughter, small adventures, and quiet moments, our love grew stronger each day. Now, surrounded by the people we cherish most, we can't wait to begin this new chapter as one.
story.title: Our Love Story

items.title: Hair-cutting ceremony for bestowing blessings
items.titleKh: ពិធីកាត់សក់បង្កក់សិរី
items.description: The wedding ceremony is a traditional Khmer event that includes rituals such as the ceremonial hair-cutting (symbolizing the cleansing of the past and the start of a new life) and the blessing of the newlyweds to bestow good fortune and prosperity upon them.
items.descriptionKh: ពិធីកាត់សក់បង្កក់សិរី គឺជាពិធីប្រពៃណីខ្មែរមួយដ៏មានសារៈសំខាន់នៅក្នុងពិធីអាពាហ៍ពិពាហ៍ ដើម្បីជម្រះឧបទ្រពចង្រៃ កោរសក់ចង្រៃចេញ និងនាំមកនូវសិរីសួស្តី សេចក្តីសុខសប្បាយដល់គូស្វាមីភរិយាថ្មី។
